subject: Agriculture
title: Mobile Money and Farmer Finance
description: A quick, practical guide to Mobile Money and Farmer Finance.

hook.text: M-Pesa lets Kenyan farmers receive payment instantly by phone—no bank, no cash, no middleman taking a cut.

buildup.text: Smallholder farmers in developing countries lack bank accounts. Cash transactions are slow, risky, and exploitative.

discovery.text: Mobile money platforms now serve over 1 billion registered accounts globally, transforming rural financial access.

twist.text: Digital payment records create credit histories. Farmers with phone records can access loans for the first time.

climax.text: Fintech companies use satellite imagery and mobile data to assess creditworthiness—lending to farmers banks ignore.

punchline.text: A phone number is the new bank account. Finance reached the farm at last.

quiz.question: How many registered accounts do mobile money platforms serve globally?
